name: pixora
description: Pixora - 本地优先的图片与游戏素材像素化工坊
author: Pixora contributors

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n WEB,API -c magenta,cyan "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @pixora/web && npm run build --workspace @pixora/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @pixora/web && npm run typecheck --workspace @pixora/api
